purpose: Preserve the full VexArchitecture alignment intention as a constrained refactor map: meaning remains with rightful owners, relationships are authored once and consumed rather than reconstructed, identities derive from existing source structure, construction is explicit, connective layers contribute mechanics without acquiring peer semantics, generated consequences are derived, invalid relationships fail at the rightful boundary, and held closure remains visibly owed until reconciled.

laws.statement: Meaning stays with the smallest owner that can answer the semantic/domain question; connective, projection, provider and execution layers must not grow peer vocabularies that restate that meaning.
antiPatterns: peer wrapper object restates an existing owner API
projection-specific vocabulary pushed upstream into semantic source
provider or execution mechanics decide Work meaning

laws.statement: A relationship is authored once at its rightful source and downstream consumers receive that relationship or its bounded projection rather than reconstructing it from names, strings, counts, comments or convention.
antiPatterns: consumer retypes stable identity from a string convention
second registry manually repeats a relationship derivable from source
prose TODO is the only carrier of an owed relationship

laws.statement: When identity already exists in authored structure, reuse or derive from that structure before minting a parallel key, token, correlation coordinate or alias.
antiPatterns: new identity layer introduced only to connect two already-related objects
provider/path/count used as semantic identity by convenience
duplicate currentness identity for the same Work/Project relationship

laws.statement: Construction and prerequisites remain source-readable and bounded; consumers receive concrete relationships and may not discover hidden dependencies through ambient lookup, reflection-like inference or repository archaeology.
antiPatterns: service-locator-style hidden lookup
relationship discovery by scanning naming conventions
future worker must search chat/history to know a prerequisite

laws.statement: Composition, integration, runtime, provider and execution layers contribute only the mechanics they rightfully own; they consume already-authored meaning and do not create a parallel feature/work vocabulary.
antiPatterns: Integration Steward becomes a WorkState owner
generated projection becomes an authoring owner
coordination claim becomes semantic Project meaning

laws.statement: Current semantic truth, historical chronology/evidence and human/debug projections remain distinct owners; one may reference another without becoming its truth source.
antiPatterns: provider timestamp treated as Work currentness
VexBoard becomes Work truth
historical checkpoint treated as present authority

laws.statement: A deterministic consequence of authoritative source is generated or checked from that source; it is not maintained as an independent handwritten truth that future workers must remember to synchronize.
antiPatterns: hand-edit generated aggregate as ordinary semantic source
hard-coded population count used as architecture
source and projection can drift while checks remain green

laws.statement: An invalid or incomplete relationship fails where it can be proven invalid; downstream readers/renderers/integrators must not silently repair, guess or normalize away the source defect.
antiPatterns: renderer guesses missing semantic relationship
integration silently drops unresolved source
validator checks only members already present and misses source-set closure

laws.statement: When a required relationship cannot yet converge lawfully, the exact unsatisfied relationship and predicate remain structurally observable until evidence clears them; a temporary hold must not decay into invisible future work.
antiPatterns: do it later lives only in PR prose
shared-path conflict causes a required consequence to disappear
absence from projection is mistaken for absence of Work

laws.statement: Proof is bound to the exact relationship claim and owner; a green structural check, provider observation, generated file, UI rendering or human screenshot cannot silently prove a different layer.
antiPatterns: green registry syntax proves discoverability closure
merge proves lived navigation
UI visibility proves canonical source currentness

relationships.constraint: Every source segment participates in deterministic composition; the checked-in canonical Workgraph must equal the composition result.
Every Project rootWorkRef must resolve in the bound canonical Workgraph and select only canonical Work descendants.
Every eligible source-managed Project must resolve exactly once into discoverability with matching Project/Board/Workgraph identity; no orphan registry entry may exist.
Public workspace is a deterministic consequence of current canonical Project + Workgraph truth and cannot remain green while those source relationships are omitted or stale.

After accepted source movement, deterministic VexWork consequences are re-derived and verified at the rightful convergence boundary; source lanes do not permanently own generated aggregate synchronization.

A required but temporarily unresolvable relationship remains visible with its exact predicate/evidence until convergence; clearing evidence removes the attention without changing WorkState by implication.
Evidence currentness is derived without becoming WorkState or transition authority.
Process routing remains source-addressable navigation and never becomes hidden execution or authority.
VexBoard receives already-owned identities/relationships and must not force VexWork to mint projection-specific semantic IDs or acquire healing/lifecycle authority.

sourceClassifications.reason: The Work lifecycle grammar, classes, authority/effect dispositions and Board-lane coverage are intentionally authored VexWork semantics; they are not consequences of enumerating Work items.
Repository admission, external identity, entry routes and culture references are intentional cross-repository relations and cannot be truthfully derived from the VexWork filesystem alone.
A reusable process is deliberately admitted and may be owned by another repository; file presence does not imply process admission or VexWork navigation.
Planning event classes and non-collapse laws define portable planning meaning rather than enumerating current Project instances.
Reconciliation dispositions and provider/proof vocabulary define a bounded interpretation contract rather than restating current provider observations.

Graph identity, canonical sourceRefs and compatibility ordering are explicit composition/migration policy; current segment membership itself is source-derived from workgraphs/segments/*.json and must not be duplicated here.

For source-managed local Projects, definition path, Board path, stable ProjectRef and ordinary shared Workgraph relation are substantially derivable from project-local source; current manual membership is the observed omission/synchronization pressure.
Accepted Workgraph Composition already defines this as the deterministic canonical value generated from segment source plus composition policy.
The public workspace is deterministically built from Project discoverability, Project definitions, Board views and canonical Workgraph truth.
The dashboard is a checked-in read projection built from Foundation Project/Board/Parking Lot truth and has no independent semantic authority.
